Porsche Technologies: Porsche Engineering and Porsche Digital combine their expertise

The international engineering services provider Porsche Engineering and the digital and software unit Porsche Digital will combine their expertise under the joint brand Porsche Technologies. This creates an integrated provider of holistic end-to-end technology solutions. The service offering is aimed at Porsche, the automotive industry, as well as other industrial and technology sectors.
Porsche Engineering and Porsche Digital will join forces under the brand Porsche Technologies in the future.

Porsche Technologies will provide holistic end-to-end technology solutions for Porsche and external customers, while expanding the offering for Porsche Engineering’s existing industrial customers with the digital capabilities of Porsche Digital.
The launch of Porsche Technologies is planned for the beginning of the second quarter of 2027.

Leadership will be assumed by Markus-Christian Eberl, currently CEO of Porsche Engineering, as CEO; Stefan Zerweck, currently CEO of Porsche Digital, as CTO; and Dirk Philipp, currently CFO/COO of Porsche Engineering, as CFO/COO.
